method: Booking.com public search, Manhattan, 2 adults, 1 room, USD, 4–5 star filter, sorted price (lowest first). Each figure is the cheapest qualifying room's displayed stay total for that exact date window, captured on 2026-11-25. Displayed totals exclude taxes/fees unless the line says 'before taxes'. Re-verify before booking.

hotel_week_prices.note: Per-hotel 7-night totals for the preferred window (2027-02-15 → 2027-02-22), 2 adults, as displayed on Booking.com room tables on 2026-11-25. 'before_tax' = room total before 14.75% tax + $4/night city tax.

2027-02-15.note: Black Friday Deal, 30% off, free cancellation before 2027-02-13, no prepayment. Tax excluded: 14.75% + $4/night city tax.

time_to_book.finding: Booking.com currently applies a property-declared 'Black Friday Deal' (valid on select stays 2026-11-19 → 2027-12-31) at several hotels. That is a dated promotional discount, not a forecast. No official source states the cheapest future booking date for these specific hotels; therefore no 'best time to book' date is asserted.
time_to_book.what_we_can_say: For the preferred window, today's displayed 7-night total (e.g., $943 pre-tax king room at DoubleTree Chelsea) reflects a live 30% promotion. Booking.com's own price-comparison/free-cancellation terms allow holding a cancellable rate now and re-checking later.
time_to_book.how_to_verify: Re-run the same saved Booking.com search weekly and log the total; the site's Booking Strategy page lists the exact saved URLs.

flags: P-01: Displayed '1 week, 2 adults' totals exclude taxes (14.75% + $4/night city tax) — true cost is higher. Booking room tables state this explicitly.
P-02: Some cheapest rooms in a window are twin/full beds (fail the queen-bed requirement) and are labelled as such.
P-03: '79% of places to stay are unavailable' banner on Booking.com for some windows indicates limited inventory in the 4–5 star band; treat all totals as volatile.
